apps.name: Convert Old Files
apps.description: Drop Publisher, WordPerfect, Works, Lotus 1-2-3, ClarisWorks and Access files and get modern files back. The files stay on this computer.

apps.name: Expenses
apps.description: A list of what was spent, with a total.

apps.name: Put files into an ISO image
apps.description: Makes one .iso disc image that holds the files you give it.

apps.name: Turn a PDF's pages into pictures
apps.description: Makes a PDF whose pages are pictures only, so text under a black box cannot be copied out.

apps.name: iPhone photos to JPEG
apps.description: Turns HEIC photos from an iPhone into JPEG pictures any program opens.

apps.name: jq playground
apps.description: Try a jq filter on some JSON. The result changes as you type.

apps.name: Markdown to Word
apps.description: Turns Markdown or plain text files into Word documents.

apps.name: Join PDFs into one
apps.description: Puts the PDFs you give it into one PDF, in the order of their names.

apps.name: Get the text out of a PDF
apps.description: Writes the text of each PDF to a plain text file, keeping its columns.

apps.name: Make pictures smaller
apps.description: Shrinks each picture to fit a size, keeping its shape. A picture that is already smaller is left as it is.

apps.name: Make scans searchable
apps.description: Turns photos or scans of pages into PDFs whose text can be searched and copied.

apps.name: Shrink a PDF
apps.description: Makes a scanned or photo-heavy PDF smaller by storing its pictures at a lower resolution.

apps.name: WAV to MP3
apps.description: Turns WAV or AIFF recordings into MP3 files a tenth of the size.

apps.name: Word to Markdown
apps.description: Turns Word, OpenDocument or web pages into Markdown text.
